hooks.command:
input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(git([[:space:]]+-[cC][[:space:]]+([^[:space:]\"']|\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')+)*[[:space:]]+(commit|tag|merge|notes)|gh[[:space:]]+(pr|issue|release|api))([[:space:]]|\$)" || exit 0
dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd'); target=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE '1s/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+("[^"]*"|[^&;|[:space:]]+).*/\1/p' | tr -d '"')
case $target in "") ;; /*) dir=$target ;; *) dir=$dir/$target ;; esac
files=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE -e "(-F|--file|--body-file)(=|[[:space:]]+)(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^[:space:]]+)" | sed -E 's/^(-F|--file|--body-file)(=|[[:space:]]+)//' | tr -d "\"'")
text=$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd"; printf '%s\n' "$files" | while IFS= read -r f; do case $f in /*) cat "$f" ;; ?*) cat "$dir/$f" ;; esac 2>/dev/null; done)
printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by:.*(claude|anthropic)|generated (with|by) \[?claude|claude\.ai/code|noreply@anthropic\.com|claude-session|🤖' && { echo 'Blocked: remove the Claude attribution from this git command or the file it uses' >&2; exit 2; }
exit 0

input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])git([[:space:]]+-[cC][[:space:]]+([^[:space:]\"']|\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|\$)" || exit 0
dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd'); target=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE '1s/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+("[^"]*"|[^&;|[:space:]]+).*/\1/p' | tr -d '"')
case $target in "") ;; /*) dir=$target ;; *) dir=$dir/$target ;; esac
value() { printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE "\"$1=[^\"]*\"|'$1=[^']*'|$1=(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^\"'[:space:]]+)" | tail -1 | sed -E "s/^[\"']?$1=//" | tr -d "\"'"; }
name=$(value 'user\.name'); email=$(value 'user\.email')
set --; [ -n "$name" ] && set -- "$@" -c "user.name=$name"; [ -n "$email" ] && set -- "$@" -c "user.email=$email"
ident=$(git -C "$dir" "$@" var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT; git -C "$dir" "$@" var GIT_COMMITTER_IDENT; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE -e "(--author(=|[[:space:]]+)|GIT_(AUTHOR|COMMITTER)_(NAME|EMAIL)=)(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^[:space:]]+)") 2>/dev/null
printf '%s' "$ident" | grep -qiE 'claude|anthropic' && { echo "Blocked: the commit author or committer is Claude. Commit with git -c user.name=<name> -c user.email=<email> commit, using the author of the user's GitHub merge commits (git log --committer=noreply@github.com -1 --format='%an <%ae>'), never the email of the Claude account. If there are none, ask" >&2; exit 2; }
exit 0
